experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2517:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20386:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4462:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1532:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:19:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2553:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20463:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20518:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2575:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20520:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4596:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2682:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20790:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:30:- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2756:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21058:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2580:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:2758:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21060:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2582:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3113:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3117:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3121:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3125:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3134:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21715:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3142:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21966:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4462:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1532:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:19:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3427:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22668:LM-ReID 更强。它有“sampling-lattice uncertainty”这个隐藏变量，有零训练 intervention，有 vs TTA 的硬切开点。PLBOA 目前是强 recipe + 好诊断，不是同等级的新问题重定义。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3526:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3578:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3598:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3600:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3605:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3641:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3659:**共同墙**: frozen foundation(DINOv2 通用/SOLIDER 行人专门)对 ReID instance prior 都弱(frozen 2.71/15.56 << fine-tuned 88+), **fine-tune 是王道**→解释 ReID 都靠 fine-tune 非 frozen retrieval; frozen-preservation/foundation-adaptation 类在 ReID 没燃料。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3666:**关联**: memory [[ag-dg-paradigm-killed-frozen-prior-weak]] [[paradigm-shift-occluded-reid-wall]]; monitor exp363_ag_foundation/exp364_dg_foundation; codex 报告 paradigm_shift/(codex_full_reid_gap/ag_verify/dg_deepen/openset_check)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3727:- epoch 40 > epoch 10（h=16 single 69.96→75.71，+5.7），lattice-marg 增益随 h 递减（+2.33→+1.01→+0.71）= 符合"分辨率升高 lattice uncertainty 消退"机制，**三个 h 全 beat TTA**。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3748:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3784:novelty：无 exact prior（sampling-lattice as LR-ReID hidden variable + marginalization）；BlurPool(aliasing)/FlipReID(flip consistency) 是相关先例；"consistency 有害"不单独成 paper 但强消融卖点。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3800:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3853:**★★detector-jitter σ-sweep（冲 7.0 detector 腿确定失败）**：均匀 ±1 离散格点改成连续 Gaussian center+scale（模拟真实检测器 localization error），扫 σ：
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3897:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:3934:LM-ReID 本地证据的核心不是“marginalization 无效”，而是更细：测试时对隐变量做决策边缘化有效；训练时把变体压成同一 embedding 或直接塑造 lattice-invariance 会伤判别性。这个约束会直接影响我后面提出的训练范式：不能再走 consistency/LCRS/LATS/LSRC 这类压缩路线。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4065:> 极端视角/模态/时间证据缺失下，低秩适配（LoRA）只学**跨帧/跨模态可验证的 residual identity evidence**，同时用**冻结 foundation teacher 的关系结构锚定 identity prior**，防 direct fine-tune 把 foundation prior 覆盖成数据集偏置。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4067:**避死区**（codex + 项目历史）：不做 uncertainty containment（CARGO σ 前提错已死）/ 不做 avg-vs-MaxSim late-interaction（已死）/ 不做 view-aware semantic experts（撞 ViSA/SD-ReID/GSAlign）/ 不做几何 alignment / 不生成 view-specific feature / 不靠 SD / 不把 CLIP prompt 当主贡献。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4141:- (c) 换 foundation **不救方向**（CLIP/EVA 仍 RGB prior 不解 IR；抬绝对值 ≠ 方法创新）。最多 CLIP-L frozen sanity 对照。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4142:- **执行**：停 AG 主线（不补 attention/view-gate/LoRA-rank 小变体=移动 kill-switch）；不先做 anchored-LoRA（oracle-chasing）；**主资源切 #2 DG/Lifelong foundation-preserving adaptation**（问题=fine-tune 时保住跨域泛化 prior，数据 Market/MSMT/Duke 现成，kill-switch 清楚）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4148:exp361 的结论也很关键：latent completion / JEPA 预训练如果让 backbone 去预测不可观测身份细节，会把判别纹理推向上下文均值，最终出现 catastrophic forgetting。这说明“训练端 posterior/generative”可以做，但必须限制在 detached head、posterior scoring、或分布参数层，不能重训 backbone 去补不存在的细节。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4190:验证前提：frozen DINOv2-reg 有无跨域 ReID prior（DG 方法的核心假设是"frozen foundation 有 prior、fine-tune 破坏它"）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4206:- codex 查文献判中（codex_dinov2_verdict.md）：2.71 是否正常 / DG 用 DINOv2 前提是否存疑（frozen prior 弱谈何破坏）/ 换 CLIP-ReID/SOLIDER / DG 降级转 open-set。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4219:- 但 15.62 不强（fine-tuned 91.6；R1 40 但 mAP 15 = top1 有信号、ranking 弱）。DG 前提靠 SOLIDER 勉强成立、prior 不强。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_lmreid_elevate.md:4240:★**DG 降 3/10，转 open-set/gallery-growth/distractor-aware lifelong**（Market/MSMT/Duke 构造协议，零训练先验，不依赖 frozen prior 强）。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:1268:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:23:DI-REID/CRReID 做**对称** resolution-invariance(LR/HR 都拉到不变空间)。AIRL **只退化 ground**(高清地面图 → aerial 像素预算),因为 aerial 已经是低预算、不该再退化。这个非对称性来自 aerial-ground 的物理结构,通用 cross-resolution 没有。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:1269:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:2052:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:2124:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:976:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:240:h=32 marginal 不是致命问题，反而支持机制：分辨率升高后 lattice uncertainty 消退。真正风险是训练版如果只比普通 TTA 高、但打不过 frozen lattice ensemble，就不像方法；如果能超过 frozen ensemble或显著降 K，故事就成立。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:2243:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1106:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:6039:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:2392:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3749:> 极端视角/模态/时间证据缺失下，低秩适配（LoRA）只学**跨帧/跨模态可验证的 residual identity evidence**，同时用**冻结 foundation teacher 的关系结构锚定 identity prior**，防 direct fine-tune 把 foundation prior 覆盖成数据集偏置。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3751:**避死区**（codex + 项目历史）：不做 uncertainty containment（CARGO σ 前提错已死）/ 不做 avg-vs-MaxSim late-interaction（已死）/ 不做 view-aware semantic experts（撞 ViSA/SD-ReID/GSAlign）/ 不做几何 alignment / 不生成 view-specific feature / 不靠 SD / 不把 CLIP prompt 当主贡献。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3792:- frozen F0（跨域 prior，不更新）+ 低秩 residual Rθ
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3800:有同质风险（都"训练破坏 foundation prior + anchor 越强越 no-op"）。区别：PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain 改 backbone 保单域判别 vs DG frozen+residual 保跨域邻域结构。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3890:- CARGO 上 AIRL dual-branch（clean f_full + recover f_rec，固定 prior 软融合）已验证 +2.37~3.76 mean。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:3905:- eval：报每方向 `{full, rec, fuse}` mAP/R1，fuse `cos = 0.25*cos_rec + 0.75*cos_full`（固定 prior，非 test-tuned）。

experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4469:- (c) 换 foundation **不救方向**（CLIP/EVA 仍 RGB prior 不解 IR；抬绝对值 ≠ 方法创新）。最多 CLIP-L frozen sanity 对照。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4470:- **执行**：停 AG 主线（不补 attention/view-gate/LoRA-rank 小变体=移动 kill-switch）；不先做 anchored-LoRA（oracle-chasing）；**主资源切 #2 DG/Lifelong foundation-preserving adaptation**（问题=fine-tune 时保住跨域泛化 prior，数据 Market/MSMT/Duke 现成，kill-switch 清楚）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4690:这里的创新不要写成“view-aware attention”，那已经撞 SD-ReID/ViSA；更好的题目是：**foundation model 如何在极端视角、尺度、模态、时间缺失下保持 identity prior**。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4693:DINOv3 明确强调 dense features 和 long training 下的 Gram anchoring；DINOv2/DINOv3 这类 SSL dense prior 对 ReID 的局部一致性很适合。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10104)) 但 2026 的 ECHO-BID/Not All Starting Points 已经提醒：CLIP/DINO/EVA/AIM 直接 fine-tune 就能在多 ReID 数据上很强，并且必须作为 baseline。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.17640))  
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4694:所以不能做“DINOv3-ReID”。可做的是：**为什么 fine-tune 会伤害跨域/长期/模态泛化，怎样用 adapter/curriculum/teacher anchoring 保住 foundation prior**。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4701:所以别做“MLLM caption + CLIP train”。更可争的是：**把 MLLM 当 noisy supervisor，生成 hard-negative rationale / missing attribute / uncertainty label，训练一个离线模型学会消歧**。
experiments/paradigm_shift/codex_next_scaleup.md:4736:这里的创新不要写成“view-aware attention”，那已经撞 SD-ReID/ViSA；更好的题目是：**foundation model 如何在极端视角、尺度、模态、时间缺失下保持 identity prior**。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2135:experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:26:RAR 用 query resolution **动态路由**选子空间。AIRL **不路由**——#3 oracle 实测硬路由(area/reliability 阈值)失败(≤+0.41),**软固定先验融合**(w=0.25,clean+recover 两证据头)反而 +1.46。所以 AIRL 的 claim 必须是 "fixed-prior fusion of clean/recover evidence heads under an observation-limited ceiling",**绝不吹成 query-budget routing**(那既撞 RAR 又与实现不符)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_related_work.md:29:> Unlike view-alignment (VDT/GSAlign) or resolution-invariance (DI-REID/CRReID) approaches, AIRL reframes aerial-ground ReID as **observation-limited identity recoverability**: it does not align views or erase degradation, but models the recoverable-evidence ceiling under an aerial pixel budget via an asymmetric ground-degradation consistency, and fuses a clean and a recover evidence head with a fixed prior — recovering the directional trade-off into a net gain without dynamic routing.

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2272:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:2326:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3456:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10683:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5693:./reassess/r_2.md:5827:reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3457:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5694:./reassess/r_2.md:5830:reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3550:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12950:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3599:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14575:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5458:reassess/r_3.md:4755:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:388:TBPS 新主线 + gait/face/跨模态搬运调研(29 agent)。**7 候选，6 死于真实顶会先例(落进已证伪区)**：VG-TBPS/common-support≈MGCC(AAAI24 遮挡TBPS)/PLOT(AAAI25)/PMA(AAAI20 pose-短语对齐)/ProFD(MM24)；其余撞 Visual-Perturbation(AAAI25)、uncertainty-aware TBPS。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3619:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14635:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5815:reassess/r_3.md:7968:./reassess/r_3.md:4152:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12460:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17653:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3969:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18827:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10683:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5693:./reassess/r_2.md:5827:reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3970:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:18828:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5694:./reassess/r_2.md:5830:reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8024:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:77:"mechanism": "Models clothing as a confounder C in a structural causal model X←C→Y and replaces likelihood training P(Y|X) with causal-intervention training P(Y|do(X))=Σ_c P(Y|X,c)·P(c) via backdoor adjustment, cutting the \"clothing shortcut\" backdoor path. Three modules implement it: a Confounder Dictionary storing each clothing item as a multivariate Gaussian N(μ,σ²) with prior P(c) (EMA-updated, clothing features isolated by reverse-attention masking of the identity map), an Intervention Module that samples K diverse per-clothing features, condition-injects them into the image feature and uses the NWGM trick (Eq.12) to pull the classifier out of the Σ_c sum so the whole intervention is one classification, and a Disentangle Regularization (orthogonal + KL + feature-separation losses) keeping clothing reps identity-free. Backbone-agnostic (ResNet-50 / ViT); causal/clothing streams used only in training, inference uses the identity stream alone.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8029:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

Market has no source frame so this is a literature-informed proxy, not real detector boxes.')

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13536:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:526:GPU1 lean probe(载 e120 ckpt 直接评 Occluded-REID, query=occluded_body/gallery=whole_body, 200 ids)：**mAP 74.79 / R1 80.60**。比 in-domain Occ-Duke 53.5 **还高**(Occ-REID 是更易 benchmark)。→ **弱 baseline 跨域不塌缩、迁移良好**。跨域(至少 Occ-Duke→Occ-REID)**不是 headroom 方向**(模型已迁移好, 只是处处弱于 SOTA = capacity 差非跨域塌缩)。**又一干净负面, 进一步收窄。** 累积排除: in-domain 特征机制(吸收)/ 组合重定义(已鲁棒)/ 跨域(不塌缩)。剩: 新监督(DUL)/ 开集 / 重量级 import。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13673:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2631:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2439:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13963:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13978:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/train_more_disentangle.txt:107:这个叙事有机会从 6/10 推到 **7/10 左右**。要到 8/10，需要 frozen probe 显示：它不是普通 augmentation，不是 pure invariance，而是确实提升了 K-marginalization 后的低分辨率检索。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14014:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14141:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14143:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14155:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:2790:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:14343:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36575:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:9:- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36577:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:14:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36592:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:31:- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36593:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36602:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:55:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36603:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:59:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36606:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36609:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:37:1. **embedding invariance hurts**: full LM 75.71 < no-LM 77.44，HR sanity 86.09 < 88.92，L_marg 主害。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36618:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:13:- **Medium-2**：LSRC 机制上确与 consistency（非拉均值）/ L_marg（非分类头 posterior）有本质区别，但默认混旧项导致无法隔离证明区别。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36643:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36662:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:132:- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36667:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14:用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36672:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4231:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36731:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36735:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36843:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36904:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8464:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1498:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4266:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36935:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9994:    14	用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37015:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13817:    13	- **Medium-2**：LSRC 机制上确与 consistency（非拉均值）/ L_marg（非分类头 posterior）有本质区别，但默认混旧项导致无法隔离证明区别。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37024:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13891:     6	训练端做 invariance / feature-collapse 压判别性 = 死路：consistency −1.73、lattice-aug 不特殊 +0.54、L_marg 训练有害大元凶。新机制必须绕开"逼 K 变体特征塌成一个点"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37026:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13894:     9	- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37028:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13899:    14	- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13951:    31	- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37044:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13952:    32	- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37045:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37053:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13975:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37054:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13979:    59	| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37057:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13985:    65	**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37112:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14386:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:59:- Uncertainty（PFE/DUL/UMTS）: 若用 A LPA，卖点是 supervised sampling-lattice posterior 非 generic data-quality。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37115:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14389:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:9:- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37116:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14390:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:14:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37164:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37188:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14624:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37205:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37318:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37320:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8390:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:878:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1282:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13652:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37335:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37347:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15095:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9892:   132	- **codex final（train4，8.5/10）判训练端确定无空间，别硬凑**：4 类全封（frozen/sidecar 无 headroom含LATS / backbone-loss 伤判别 / robust-ERM 没赢 / BLC 逻辑封住）。训练端定论穷尽（8 机制 + 4 codex）→ 转 test-time 论文 + "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 反例节。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37349:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9994:    14	用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15204:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37412:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15362:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13894:     9	- **LPA（Lattice Posterior Amortization，lens3 #1）**：冻结 backbone，只训小头预测 posterior qφ(z|x)（z=bbox/phase/kernel 格点），测试时 `score = logsumexp_z[log qφ(z|q) + cos(fθ(Tz q), fθ(g))/τ]`，uniform → posterior 加权。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37413:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15363:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13899:    14	- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37423:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15376:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13951:    31	- **LATS**：frozen-adaptation 子类（LS-MRT final-feat 已证 +0.028 无 headroom），token map cache ~18GB **不 cheap**，codex 期望 +0.0~0.2。**★实测（2026-06-26 用户质疑"LM-ReID 没训练端创新吗"后, cvpb_lats_probe.py cheaper stripe-pooled 版, frozen backbone + 6-stripe token sidecar）= 死 −5.147**（uniform-global marg 80.23 → stripe-LATS 75.09；K-cos rise +0.023 变体趋同）。机理: stripe sidecar set-retrieval 训练把 K 变体拉相似破坏 marginalization 多样性, **和 LSRC 一个死法**（训练端塑造/对齐变体即损害 test-time marginalization 多样性）。**→ LATS 从"外推判死"升级"实测死"**：frozen-adaptation 类两个实测点（LS-MRT final-feat +0.028 / LATS stripe-token −5.147），连 pool-前 token 空间信息都试过。用户质疑价值=穷尽从外推→实测, "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"论点更硬。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37424:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15377:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13952:    32	- **paperstrategy 论文可投性**：test-time + 反例上限 **6.5**（BLC 证伪 → 够不到 7.5）。论文转 "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails"（三类反例写成"自然但错误的解法"）+ 补实验。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37425:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37431:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15384:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13975:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37432:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15385:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13979:    59	| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37435:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15390:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13985:    65	**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37553:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16663:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:32:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
