experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37582:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37607:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17080:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37620:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17127:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2573:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6583:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37624:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17133:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2595:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6667:核心证据是 `M=3 no-LM-loss` 已经最强：`77.44 single / 79.90 lattice`，而 full LM 反而 `75.71 / 78.04`。这说明“feature consistency/invariance”死了，但“lattice hidden variable + marginalization”没死。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37634:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:17148:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2701:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_post_kanmen.md:83:你的关键证据是四LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37635:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34446:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32628:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10814:   834	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1236:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37644:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34455:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32637:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37659:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34471:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32681:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13975:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37679:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34492:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32766:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14519:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14:用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37681:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34494:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32768:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14530:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:203:experiments/decisions.md:4708:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37682:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34495:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32769:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14579:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:458:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:816:experiments/decisions.md:4708:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37683:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34496:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32771:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34512:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32790:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14624:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34517:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32800:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14671:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37718:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34531:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32818:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:7227:experiments/decisions.md:4708:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37720:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34534:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32864:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14969:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8283:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14:用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34538:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14974:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:522:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:891:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34554:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32888:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:14998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8374:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:862:experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37745:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34559:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32898:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:8455:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:1489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37750:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34564:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32907:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:9994:    14	用户质疑 LM-ReID 训练端 8 机制负结果可信度, 要查当时代码正确性(别凭'当时负'打发, 可能代码 bug)。逐行审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py(LM-ReID 训练端实验脚本)。**审 3 点诚实判**: (a)**代码正确性**: 8 机制实现(consistency/embedding-invariance 实测 −1.73, Hard-Lattice robust-ERM 76.9<77.44, input-canonicalize/BLC, frozen-adaptation 等)逐行查 bug——糊法/lattice 合成是否正确(phase/bbox/kernel 变体)、loss 计算(consistency/triplet/CE)、train/test 是否对称、backbone+ckpt 加载、HR/LR 处理、评估口径。**负结果(−1.73/76.9)是真负还是代码 bug?** (b)**用户想法是否真验过**: 用户提'训练时合成多糊法综合判断'+'多糊法特征尽可能相同'。这两个(+你当时建议的 LCRS Lattice-Complementary Residual Subspaces 残差 decorrelation / sampling-lattice canonicalization)在 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 里**实际训练过吗, 还是停在设计/codex 建议没跑**? 如果没跑, 是真没试的角度。(c)综合: 当时'训练端穷尽'结论可信吗(代码对+真跑过)? 还是有 bug 或没跑的机制(尤其 LCRS)值得重做? 读 cvpb_lm_reid_train.py + 相关 monitor/decisions。诚实务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37764:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34578:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27093:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15204:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:10842:   862	experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1266:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37772:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34587:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:32934:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27106:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:21353:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:15378:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:13954:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37823:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34640:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33000:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27764:    34	**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37824:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34641:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33005:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27785:    55	LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37825:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34642:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33008:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27795:    65	**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37827:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34644:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33012:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:27989:experiments/decisions.md:4708:- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37837:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34654:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33037:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:34:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37845:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34662:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33088:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28773:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**从相邻领域搬训练机制**治理lattice-latent: deep-sets/permutation-invariant、group-equivariance、neural-process、test-time-training训练侧、metric-learning-with-nuisance-factor、DRO。最值1-2个。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37861:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34678:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33216:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:28907:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34709:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33274:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29304:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34711:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33276:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29306:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34727:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33293:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29395:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7654:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:2811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_setwise.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=**训练目标对齐test-time(set-wise/amortize)**: 训练时直接用K-variant set与gallery做logsumexp/set相似度优化(不压特征不求均值), 把边缘化amortize进网络。和失败的L_marg(求softmax均值)区别在哪?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34736:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33304:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:12852:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34738:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33307:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29426:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13652:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34744:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33315:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:29986:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37961:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34778:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33436:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37962:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34779:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33437:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30548:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37967:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34784:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33446:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30558:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2813:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:18:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37987:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34804:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30626:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4649:**不做**（codex 共判）：TTT/TENT(无标签自我确认 3/10), DRO/Hard-Lattice(≈将死 4/10), PFE-Gaussian(query-side uncertainty 不够 4/10)。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:37992:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34809:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33506:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30639:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4872:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34833:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33549:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30693:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38017:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34834:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33550:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30694:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38018:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34835:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33557:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30707:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6455:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_diversity.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38028:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34845:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33579:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:30845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38072:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34889:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31011:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4004:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38074:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34891:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:31026:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38082:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34899:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33732:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38083:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34900:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33733:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:1837:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38089:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34906:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33744:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:2813:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:1973:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:18:LPA(A 加权头)定死（oracle headroom +4.338 不可达，最佳变体 query+gallery 共定单看 query 预测不出 acc≈chance）。Hard-Lattice ERM eval 中。按用户"这三个不行就找更多"启 4 新 codex（litreview2/train_more_*.md），收敛到 **5 个候选**，全避开已死的（invariance-collapse / query-side 预测最佳变体 / L_marg 分类头边缘化）。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38123:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34941:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4991:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_paperstrategy.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38144:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34962:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33871:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:6408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38154:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34972:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38158:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:34976:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33952:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38184:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35002:./experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:33999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/d17_eval.md:4257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38194:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:35139:  4708	- **训练端穷尽(8 机制 + 4 codex 8.5/10 无空间)**: embedding-invariance(consistency −1.73)/frozen-adaptation(LS-MRT +0.028/LPA +0.075/LATS)/backbone-loss(LSRC −1.9 损判别)/robust-ERM(Hard-Lattice 76.9<77.44)/input-canonicalize(BLC 数据证伪)全负 → "Why Training-Time Invariance Fails" 强论点。审查纪律: LSRC full-finetune codex 审出 Critical(默认混旧 loss)+High(train/test 不对称)已修[[pre-experiment-review-discipline]]。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:38197:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:36260:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_train_correctness.md:16822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_disentangle.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让模型**显式分离lattice因子disentangle**: lattice-conditioned representation或adversarial把lattice当nuisance factor分出去, 推理时干净marginalize残差身份。为何不重蹈L_marg有害?

# 实验 exp331: Identity-Conditioned Aleatoric Embedding (DUL) — 新监督/目标类

## 动机
- 今晚证负一整片：in-domain 特征机制(吸收)、组合重定义(已鲁棒)、跨域(不塌缩)。剩没测的类 = **新监督/目标**。
- 调研 agent Rank-2 bet = **DUL (Data Uncertainty Learning, Chang et al. CVPR 2020, arXiv:2003.11339)**，搬自人脸识别（遮挡/噪声下）。
- **为何可能逃过"训练吸收"（scout 论点）**：DUL 给模型一个**新自由度（per-image aleatoric 方差 σ²，联合学）**——是新容量而非可被重新提取的冗余结构。**非 PFE**（PFE 冻结模型外挂方差头=已死的后处理类）；DUL 的 σ² 在训练中**反向改 μ**（KL 项把难/遮挡样本拉向类心）。

## 核心假设
遮挡导致 aleatoric 不确定性。让 backbone 输出分布嵌入 (μ, σ²)，σ² **训练中联合学**预测自身不确定性；ID loss 作用在采样 s=μ+ε·σ 上（reparameterization），σ² 经 KL 反向正则 μ。遮挡样本应学到高 σ²、μ 被拉向类心 → 遮挡 mAP ↑。

## 技术方案（substrate = 弱 TransReID vit_base @ hyy）
- 复用 TransReID `make_dataloader`（标准 Occ-Duke train + RandomErasing + PK sampler）+ `make_model` + `make_optimizer` + `create_scheduler`（与 53.5 baseline 同 pipeline）。
- **variance head**：`Linear(768→768)` 输出 per-channel `log σ²`，**零初始化 → log σ²=0 → σ²=1**（起点 = σ²=1 单位高斯**先验**，**非确定性**——采样即注入单位噪声；早期 CE 会自然压 σ↓，据此解读塌缩，Codex Medium）。
- **DUL 前向**：μ=global_feat（model 返回）；logvar=var_head(μ)；σ=exp(0.5·logvar)；ε~N(0,I)；**s=μ+ε·σ**；score=model.classifier(model.bottleneck(s))。
- **loss**：ID CE 作用在 score（采样 s）；triplet 作用在 μ；**KL=0.5·mean(μ² + σ² − logvar − 1)**（real DUL KL(N(μ,σ²)‖**N(0,I)**)，正则 μ→0(拉向类心) + σ→1 防塌常数）；total = CE + triplet + λ_kl·KL（λ_kl=0.01）。**注**：μ² 项与 ID/triplet 判别性张力——若 μ→0 伤检索即 DUL 在 ReID 失败原因。
- **BN 单更新**（Claude H2 修）：sample 路 `model.bottleneck` 置 eval（不更新 running stats），BN 只在 clean μ 上更一次（=det），保单变量 + 防噪声样本污染 eval。
- **单变量对照 = deterministic**（无 var_head、无采样、无 KL，CE 直接作用在原 score；同 scaffold/seed/epoch）。

## Kill-switch（训练模型判据）
- **GO**：DUL 的 μ-matching Occ-Duke mAP **≥ deterministic +1.0** **且 σ² 非退化**（ρ(σ², occlusion) 显著：query(遮挡) 平均 σ² 明显 > gallery(整体)，diff>0 且统计显著）。
- **NO-GO**：mAP Δ<+0.5 **或** σ² 塌成常数（query≈gallery σ²）→ 退化成确定性 + no-op（正是 exp140 confidence 塌 0.99 的死法）。σ² 退化检查是关键 guard。
- **诚实风险**（scout 提）：σ² 极易塌成常数 → dead-on-arrival。kill-switch 的 σ²-occlusion 检查专防此。

## 评测
- Occ-Duke 标准 test（val_loader, R1_mAP_eval, μ-matching）mAP vs deterministic。
- σ² 诊断：抽 query/gallery 每图 σ².mean()，比均值（遮挡是否更高 σ²）。

## 对照组
- deterministic（同 scaffold 无 DUL）vs DUL，单变量=variance head + DUL loss + 采样。
- backbone TransReID vit_base 弱 baseline（~53.5）。不混 NFC/RR。

## 预期
- GO：σ² 学到遮挡不确定性、μ 被正则 → 遮挡 mAP +1~3。
- NO-GO（最可能）：σ² 塌常数（KL 太强/数据无信号）→ 退化确定性。则记录、DUL 死。

## 实现/审查
- self-contained `scripts/exp331_dul.py`（--mode {det,dul}）。Claude broad review + Codex review（hook 双门）→ smoke → 训练 det(GPU0 after ERM) + dul(GPU1) 120ep 单变量。

---

## ⛔ KILL-SWITCH 判决 (2026-06-17, e20+e40 双确认)
| epoch | DET mAP | DUL mAP | Δ(dul−det) | σ² mean | σ² query(occ) vs gallery(hol) diff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 48.51 | 47.16 | **−1.35** | 0.2555 | −0.0244 (occ 反而**更低**) |
| 40 | 50.93 | 48.98 | **−1.95**(扩大) | 0.1739(↓收缩) | −0.0183 (仍反向) |
- **NO-GO，双判据全失败**：(1) DUL mAP < DET 且 gap 扩大(−1.35→−1.95)，需 ≥+1.0 完全反向；(2) σ² 非塌到0但**缓慢收缩(0.256→0.174)** + **遮挡相关性反号**(遮挡 σ² 更低，应更高)→ σ² 没建模遮挡不确定性。
- **机制**：reparameterization 噪声伤 ReID 判别(sampling 降辨识)；学到的 σ² 不捕捉遮挡(反号+收缩)。正是 Claude M1 预言的失败(σ²→0/no-op，此处变体=伤+反号)。
- KILL exp331。**"新监督/目标"类(DUL)在 occluded ReID 也无 headroom。**

# 实验 exp155: Evidential Deep Learning for GCN Branch

## 动机

当前 GCN branch 用 CrossEntropy 分类。CE 对所有样本施加均匀梯度压力——不管样本是否被遮挡，都要求高置信预测。这对遮挡样本可能是有害的（强迫模型编码"虚假置信度"）。

Evidential DL（Sensoy et al., NeurIPS 2018）将分类头改为 Dirichlet 分布参数预测。模型不只预测"哪个类"，还预测"对这个预测有多确信"。对遮挡样本，Evidential loss 允许模型说"我不确定"而不是被强迫给出高置信错误预测。

**这从根本上改变了"模型输出什么"——从点估计概率到概率分布上的分布。**

## 文献定位

- Sensoy et al. (NeurIPS 2018): Evidential DL 原始论文，用于 MNIST/CIFAR
- 医学影像领域广泛使用（部分观测、缺失数据场景）
- **从未在 person ReID 中使用过**

## 技术方案

### 只改 GCN branch 的 ID loss

```
Global branch:  Linear(768, 702) → CrossEntropy  [不变]
GCN branch:     Linear(768, 702) → softplus → α = evidence + 1 → Evidential Loss  [改]
Triplet:        两个 branch 各自不变
```

### Evidential Loss = Bayes Risk + KL Regularization

```
Bayes Risk = Σ_k y_k * (log S - log α_k)     # S = Σα_k
KL = KL(Dir(α̃) || Dir(1,...,1))               # α̃ removes true-class evidence
Total = Bayes Risk + λ * anneal * KL
```

KL 退火：从 0 线性增长到 1.0，在 60% epochs (ep72) 达到满值。

### 关键日志

- `evid_br`: Bayes Risk（应类似 CE loss 的量级）
- `evid_kl`: KL 散度（应从 0 开始随 annealing 增长）
- `evid_unc`: 平均 uncertainty（K/S，0~1，越低越确信）
- `evid_ev`: 平均 evidence（Σα-K，越高越确信）
- `evid_ann`: 退火系数

## 对照组

- exp030a (baseline, 60.73% mAP 3-seed mean)
- exp153 (MaxSim additive, ~60.6% mAP, 中性)

## 预期结果

- 如果 Evidential 让 feature 空间"更诚实"：mAP 微正 (+0.3~1.0)
- 如果 KL 正则过强导致 GCN branch 学不好：mAP 负
- 关键看 `evid_unc`: 如果遮挡样本确实显示更高 uncertainty → 机制生效

## 风险

1. K=702 时 KL 绝对值很大，kl_reg=0.1 可能仍然太高
2. Evidential loss 梯度量级与 CE 不同，可能需要调 loss weight
3. AMP 下 lgamma/digamma 精度不够 → 已 force float32

## 止损

- ep30 mAP 低于 exp030a ep30 (52.2%) 2.0% 以上 → 止损
- evid_kl 爆炸（>100）→ 降低 kl_reg

现在结论开始清楚：若把“posterior”理解成 closed-set softmax/Dirichlet/Gaussian embedding，先例已经不少，而且仓库里 DUL、Evidential、PSC-JEPA 都给了负面证据。可活的窄缝要改成“开放集 identity evidence 的后验/生成式索引/配对证据分布”，并且第一步必须用冻结特征 kill-switch 证明它不是普通 uncertainty head。

     1	# 实验 exp331: Identity-Conditioned Aleatoric Embedding (DUL) — 新监督/目标类
     2	
     3	## 动机
     4	- 今晚证负一整片：in-domain 特征机制(吸收)、组合重定义(已鲁棒)、跨域(不塌缩)。剩没测的类 = **新监督/目标**。
     5	- 调研 agent Rank-2 bet = **DUL (Data Uncertainty Learning, Chang et al. CVPR 2020, arXiv:2003.11339)**，搬自人脸识别（遮挡/噪声下）。
     6	- **为何可能逃过"训练吸收"（scout 论点）**：DUL 给模型一个**新自由度（per-image aleatoric 方差 σ²，联合学）**——是新容量而非可被重新提取的冗余结构。**非 PFE**（PFE 冻结模型外挂方差头=已死的后处理类）；DUL 的 σ² 在训练中**反向改 μ**（KL 项把难/遮挡样本拉向类心）。
     7	
     8	## 核心假设
     9	遮挡导致 aleatoric 不确定性。让 backbone 输出分布嵌入 (μ, σ²)，σ² **训练中联合学**预测自身不确定性；ID loss 作用在采样 s=μ+ε·σ 上（reparameterization），σ² 经 KL 反向正则 μ。遮挡样本应学到高 σ²、μ 被拉向类心 → 遮挡 mAP ↑。
    10	
    11	## 技术方案（substrate = 弱 TransReID vit_base @ hyy）
    12	- 复用 TransReID `make_dataloader`（标准 Occ-Duke train + RandomErasing + PK sampler）+ `make_model` + `make_optimizer` + `create_scheduler`（与 53.5 baseline 同 pipeline）。
    13	- **variance head**：`Linear(768→768)` 输出 per-channel `log σ²`，**零初始化 → log σ²=0 → σ²=1**（起点 = σ²=1 单位高斯**先验**，**非确定性**——采样即注入单位噪声；早期 CE 会自然压 σ↓，据此解读塌缩，Codex Medium）。
    14	- **DUL 前向**：μ=global_feat（model 返回）；logvar=var_head(μ)；σ=exp(0.5·logvar)；ε~N(0,I)；**s=μ+ε·σ**；score=model.classifier(model.bottleneck(s))。
    15	- **loss**：ID CE 作用在 score（采样 s）；triplet 作用在 μ；**KL=0.5·mean(μ² + σ² − logvar − 1)**（real DUL KL(N(μ,σ²)‖**N(0,I)**)，正则 μ→0(拉向类心) + σ→1 防塌常数）；total = CE + triplet + λ_kl·KL（λ_kl=0.01）。**注**：μ² 项与 ID/triplet 判别性张力——若 μ→0 伤检索即 DUL 在 ReID 失败原因。
    16	- **BN 单更新**（Claude H2 修）：sample 路 `model.bottleneck` 置 eval（不更新 running stats），BN 只在 clean μ 上更一次（=det），保单变量 + 防噪声样本污染 eval。
    17	- **单变量对照 = deterministic**（无 var_head、无采样、无 KL，CE 直接作用在原 score；同 scaffold/seed/epoch）。
    18	
    19	## Kill-switch（训练模型判据）
    20	- **GO**：DUL 的 μ-matching Occ-Duke mAP **≥ deterministic +1.0** **且 σ² 非退化**（ρ(σ², occlusion) 显著：query(遮挡) 平均 σ² 明显 > gallery(整体)，diff>0 且统计显著）。
    21	- **NO-GO**：mAP Δ<+0.5 **或** σ² 塌成常数（query≈gallery σ²）→ 退化成确定性 + no-op（正是 exp140 confidence 塌 0.99 的死法）。σ² 退化检查是关键 guard。
    22	- **诚实风险**（scout 提）：σ² 极易塌成常数 → dead-on-arrival。kill-switch 的 σ²-occlusion 检查专防此。
    23	
    24	## 评测
    25	- Occ-Duke 标准 test（val_loader, R1_mAP_eval, μ-matching）mAP vs deterministic。
    26	- σ² 诊断：抽 query/gallery 每图 σ².mean()，比均值（遮挡是否更高 σ²）。
    27	
    28	## 对照组
    29	- deterministic（同 scaffold 无 DUL）vs DUL，单变量=variance head + DUL loss + 采样。
    30	- backbone TransReID vit_base 弱 baseline（~53.5）。不混 NFC/RR。
    31	
    32	## 预期
    33	- GO：σ² 学到遮挡不确定性、μ 被正则 → 遮挡 mAP +1~3。
    34	- NO-GO（最可能）：σ² 塌常数（KL 太强/数据无信号）→ 退化确定性。则记录、DUL 死。
    35	
    36	## 实现/审查
    37	- self-contained `scripts/exp331_dul.py`（--mode {det,dul}）。Claude broad review + Codex review（hook 双门）→ smoke → 训练 det(GPU0 after ERM) + dul(GPU1) 120ep 单变量。
    38	
    39	---
    40	
    41	## ⛔ KILL-SWITCH 判决 (2026-06-17, e20+e40 双确认)
    42	| epoch | DET mAP | DUL mAP | Δ(dul−det) | σ² mean | σ² query(occ) vs gallery(hol) diff |
    43	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    44	| 20 | 48.51 | 47.16 | **−1.35** | 0.2555 | −0.0244 (occ 反而**更低**) |
    45	| 40 | 50.93 | 48.98 | **−1.95**(扩大) | 0.1739(↓收缩) | −0.0183 (仍反向) |
    46	- **NO-GO，双判据全失败**：(1) DUL mAP < DET 且 gap 扩大(−1.35→−1.95)，需 ≥+1.0 完全反向；(2) σ² 非塌到0但**缓慢收缩(0.256→0.174)** + **遮挡相关性反号**(遮挡 σ² 更低，应更高)→ σ² 没建模遮挡不确定性。
    47	- **机制**：reparameterization 噪声伤 ReID 判别(sampling 降辨识)；学到的 σ² 不捕捉遮挡(反号+收缩)。正是 Claude M1 预言的失败(σ²→0/no-op，此处变体=伤+反号)。
    48	- KILL exp331。**"新监督/目标"类(DUL)在 occluded ReID 也无 headroom。**

**结论**
可以升华，但不能升华成“训练端把 nuisance 变体对齐成同一 embedding”。本地 LM-ReID 已经把这条路钉死：`L_marg/L_cons` 比 no-LM 低 `-1.73`，LSRC 也掉 `-1.92`，而 test-time lattice marginalization 仍稳定有效，见 [exp359 monitor](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:67)。所以范式级训练侧创新只剩一个窄缝：

> 不训练模型“消灭隐变量”，而训练模型输出或使用 **identity evidence posterior**，让检索阶段做 posterior / evidence-level inference。

**先例边界**
PFE 已经把单图 embedding 表成 Gaussian：均值是最可能特征，方差是不确定性，并用于匹配/融合。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.09658)) DUL 又进一步把均值和方差联合学习。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.11339)) ReID 里 2020 已有“sample posterior + class prior Gaussian + KL distribution loss”的直接先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785)) 2026 CARE 则把 evidential calibration / evidence propagation 用在 noisy-label ReID。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23133))

所以，**“预测 identity distribution 而非 point embedding”本身不新**。新意必须落在：
1. 不是 closed-set train-ID posterior；
2. 不是单图 Gaussian 方差；
3. 不是噪声标签 uncertainty；
4. 而是开放集检索中的 **不完整观测 identity evidence posterior**。

2024-2026 相关方向也没完全占掉这个缝：KPR 重定义了多人体 bbox 下的 target ambiguity，但靠 keypoint prompt 指定目标，不是 identity posterior inference。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.18112)) Diffusion-ReID / Pose-dIVE 占的是生成式数据增强和 pose/view 扩增，不是检索时的身份后验。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.06045)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.16042)) 2025 的 IB-ReID 用 Information Bottleneck 让 attention 更 informative，但仍是 attention/feature selection，不是隐变量 posterior。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08961)) VPFA 处理 cross-resolution feature direction，也不是 sampling-lattice posterior。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936))

**三个可做方向**
1. **GIP-ReID: Generative Identity Posterior / 离散身份证据码**
把 gallery identity 表成离散 code 序列或 product-quantized evidence tokens。Query 不输出一个 embedding，而输出 `p(code_1...code_m | x)`；检索是生成式候选召回 + 原特征 rerank。

区别：不是 train-ID softmax，而是对开放集 gallery-compatible identity code 做 posterior。它天然允许不完整观测输出宽 posterior。

kill-switch：
- 冻结现有强特征，先做 PQ / residual codebook。
- 测 `top-L code recall`：同 ID gallery 是否在 query posterior 的 top-128/256 候选里。
- 过线：`top-256 recall >= 95%` 且候选 rerank mAP 不低于 baseline `-0.2`；不过直接杀。
- 资源：单卡几小时，主要是离线特征和轻量 code head。

判定：**最像范式级，novelty 最高，风险也高。CCF-B 潜力 7/10，先跑 cheap kill-switch。**

2. **PEP-ReID: Pairwise Evidence Posterior / 配对证据分布匹配**
每张图输出一组 part/evidence posterior：`{mu_k, sigma_k, visibility_k, reliability_k}`。检索不是 scalar confidence，而是 pair-specific posterior overlap：

`score(q,g)=log ∑_k exp(sim(mu_qk, mu_gk) / combined_uncertainty_k)`

关键点：方差必须改变不同 gallery 的排序；query 级 scalar uncertainty 没用，因为它只会整体平移同一 query 的所有 gallery 分数。

避坑：
- 不把 variance 采样进 CE 路径，避免 DUL 那种 sampling 伤判别性。本地 DUL 已负，遮挡样本方差还反号，见 [exp331](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp331_dul/design.md:41)。
- 不替换主 backbone，只训练 detached posterior/scorer head。
- 不做变体 consistency。

kill-switch：
- 用 exp030a / PLBOA / MaxSim 特征，冻结 backbone。
- 训练一个 tiny posterior scorer，只吃 part/keypoint/global evidence。
- 对比 `equal_concat`、`MaxSim`、CVK。
- 过线：mAP `+0.3~0.5`，且 uncertainty 与 support-incomplete 指标正相关；R1 不掉超过 `0.3`。
- 资源：1 单卡半天；失败就不进 backbone 训练。

判定：**最务实，容易与 LM-ReID 洞察衔接。CCF-B 潜力 6.5/10。**

3. **CEB-ReID: Conditional Evidence Bottleneck / 非坍缩信息瓶颈**
不要做普通 VIB：`min I(z;nuisance)` 很可能杀身份细节。应该拆成：
- `c`: identity core，弱去 nuisance；
- `r_u`: nuisance-conditioned residual evidence，必须保留多样性；
- score 用 `c + marginalize(r_u)`，而不是把所有 `r_u` 压到均值。

训练约束：
- `I(c;ID)` 高；
- `I(c;u)` 低；
- `I(r_u;u)` 保持下限；
- same-ID 不要求所有 nuisance variant 相同，只要求 posterior score 对正样本高、负样本低。

kill-switch：
- 冻结特征先做 probe：线性 nuisance probe 能否从 residual 中读出 pose/view/lattice，同时 identity probe 不掉。
- 再做 last-block 10 epoch 小训。
- 过线：clean/HR mAP 不低于 baseline `-0.3`，occluded/LR mAP `+0.5`，feature rank/tok_std 不坍缩。
- 资源：2 单卡并行做 baseline 和 CEB；一天内能杀。

判定：**理论好写，但最容易重蹈六点定律。只作为第三优先级，CCF-B 潜力 5.5~6/10。**

**最终建议**
第一步不要开 full training。先做 **GIP code-recall kill-switch** 和 **PEP frozen posterior scorer** 两个零/轻训练实验。它们都不塑造变体、不压缩 embedding、不补不可观测身份细节，符合 LM-ReID 给出的硬约束。若两者都不过，说明“posterior/generative inference”在现有 4 单卡和标准 ReID 数据上也没有足够训练端燃料。
